scientific_scope.import_core: Parse mzML into BuildingMzMLMsScan records without project or GUI integration.
scientific_scope.mass_detection_core: Apply the exact public CentroidMassDetector array overload with an explicit noise level.
excluded_from_oracle: account, authentication, event, and cloud services

io.github.mzmine.taskcontrol.AbstractTas.reason: The oracle calls parseMzMl directly. JavaFX listeners, scheduling, priority handling, and application task services are excluded. The adapter preserves only the state used by MzMLFileImportMethod.

io.github.mzmine.util.MemoryMapStorage.reason: The public parser references a type absent from the frozen public source tree. The fork supplies a behavior-free type only so the exact public null-storage path can compile; no constructor, factory, memory-map, cleanup, or persistence behavior is reconstructed.
preserved_members: type identity for nullable arguments only

io.github.mzmine.modules.io.import_rawda.reason: The oracle uses an independently defined always-match, identity-processing configuration. Manufacturer inference and GUI/batch configuration are excluded while the selected source MS level and centroid stage remain explicit settings outside the parser.

The oracle preserves the primitive m/z and intensity array container used by parser processing. Constructors that accept application Scan objects are excluded so the complete scan, frame, feature, project, and GUI graph is not pulled into the oracle.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.MetadataOnlyS.reason: BuildingMzMLMsScan requires an abstract override surface, but the complete application Scan hierarchy is excluded. The adapter declares only methods overridden by the unchanged public building record.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.RawDataFile.reason: BuildingMzMLMsScan exposes a RawDataFile return type, but the oracle normalizes BuildingMzMLMsScan values directly, never constructs or registers an application RawDataFile, and getDataFile returns null.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.MobilityType.reason: The governed first oracle is non-IMS LC-MS and does not construct frames. The unchanged public parser can still classify recognized mobility CV terms, so metadata identity constants are retained without application formatting or IMS feature dependencies.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.impl.DDAMsMsI.reason: The parser oracle records precursor, activation, isolation-window, and charge values directly from mzML building records. The application object constructor is retained for source compatibility but must fail explicitly if executed.
preserved_members: DDAMsMsInfoImpl(Double, Integer, Float, MetadataOnlyScan, MetadataOnlyScan, int, ActivationMethod, Range<Double>) throwing UnsupportedOperationException

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.msms.MsMsInfo.reason: Application-level precursor object persistence is excluded; normalized precursor fields are emitted directly from public parser isolation records.

io.github.mzmine.util.DataPointUtils.reason: Only the DoubleBuffer conversion used by BuildingMzMLMsScan m/z range calculation is retained. Feature conversion methods in the same utility class are excluded.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.featuredata.i.reason: Only the null-storage in-memory buffer conversion needed by parsed scan records is retained. Feature-series storage and memory-map lifecycle are outside the non-IMS parser oracle, and non-null storage is rejected.

io.github.mzmine.main.MZmineCore.reason: Scientific data enums reference MZmineCore for display formatting. The oracle records canonical enum names and does not execute application bootstrap, GUI, account, event, or cloud services.

io.github.mzmine.modules.dataprocessing..reason: The oracle preserves and executes the exact public primitive-array overload. Interface, GUI parameter, isotope-below-noise, and MassSpectrum overload dependencies are outside the explicit centroid noise-level comparison.
GUI-backed parameter formatting and setup dialogs are excluded. The explicit numeric noise level is recorded in the differential settings contract.
